title: Supreme Court Issues Notice to Election Commission Over Unauthorised Form 6 Changes
detail: India's Supreme Court issued notice to the Election Commission of India and the Centre over changes to Form 6 (voter registration), stating the changes were not court-ordered. The ruling is a key legal development in the ongoing CEC Gyanesh Kumar protest movement, which has centred on demands for Kumar's resignation over the electoral-roll revision process.

media.caption: Supreme Court issues notice over Form 6 changes in CEC Gyanesh Kumar protest case
